correctness.rationale: The matching-type formula counts ordered endpoints modulo edge-type permutations. The inner-inverse criterion is proved from strict map definitions in both directions; covering is automatic because each domain matching edge meets the complement of the image part. Two-level inclusion-exclusion yields common-part matchings; idempotents are pinned by fixed endpoints. Three-part and four-part edge-type obstructions yield the exact regularity trichotomy. Fixed-part-size asymptotics follow from complete-graph matching counts minus O(r^{2k-1}) forbidden matchings, with the top rank dominating. The standalone verifier checked 15 exact profiles and four direct inner-inverse enumerations.

The earlier equal-size complete bipartite count is strictly narrower in graph scope and is not a new result claimed here. Current-period earlier counts for partition-preserving total transformations address a different semigroup and do not imply edge-fiber matchings-to-image coefficients.
